remarks: Stunning 5 bedroom, 2.5 bath colonial in West Norwalk! - Totally renovated kitchen featuring white shaker-style cabinets, quartz counters, subway tile backsplash, range hood, and stainless steel appliances! - Large island in kitchen features wine chiller / beverage fridge - Great entertaining space on 1st floor with open dining room, leading into family room + additional den / playroom - 5 bedrooms all on the 2nd floor including primary bedroom suite with custom subway tile standing shower! - Good closet space - Updated hallway bathroom with tile shower surround - Hardwood floors throughout! - Updated LED lighting - Sliding door opens to private deck with custom cable railing system overlooking back yard - Great storage space in walk-out basement - 2 car attached garage || ** Highest and best requested by Tuesday 4/29 @ 3:00 pm **
